observations: Draft fields remain readable in the retained portrait/landscape states; the List origin and editor stay separate.
All-day invalid and inclusive ranges show their native warning/Save states and persist in the saved row.
Optional-end and timezone changes retain saved details and source selection after relaunch.
Stacked floating tabs/toolbar/search, duplicate titles and technical footer wording remain whole-app polish items.
limits: Focused ordinary-size iPad workflows; no Mac, physical, full accessibility or whole-app visual acceptance.
